title: BOSCH GBM 400 Professional Corded Drill Machine | 420W...
description: The BOSCH GBM 400 Professional Drill Machine keyless version is a compact and powerful corded drill designed for reliable drilling and screwdriving applications. Built with a high-performance motor and slim ergonomic design, this drill provides efficient operation while remaining comfortable to use even during extended work sessions. Its compact body makes it easy to handle and ideal for working in narrow or hard-to-reach areas such as cabinets and corners. Equipped with a 10mm keyed chuck, the drill ensures secure holding of drill bits for stable and precise drilling. The variable speed control with up to 3100 RPM allows users to adjust the drilling speed depending on the material and application, giving better accuracy and control. Designed for versatility, the drill can efficiently work on wood, metal and plastic, making it suitable for professionals such as electricians, carpenters, and technicians as well as DIY users. Its durable construction and reliable performance make it a dependable tool for everyday drilling tasks.
